name: AnyReplay
author: techbaem

sections.description:
AnyReplay records what visitors do on your site, clicks, scrolls, taps and the pages they move through, so you can watch a session back and see where people got stuck.

This plugin adds the AnyReplay recorder to your front-end pages. It is the same script you would otherwise paste into your theme, with a settings page instead of code:

  • Project key from your AnyReplay project.
  • Mask form fields, on by default, so what visitors type replays as asterisks. Untick it to see typed values.
  • Wait for consent using the WP Consent API, so nothing is recorded until a visitor allows statistics cookies.
  • Sample rate and a monthly session cap to control how much is recorded.
  • Skip administrators so your own visits do not fill the session list.

The admin area is never recorded. You need an AnyReplay account; the free plan includes a monthly allowance of sessions.

External service

This plugin loads a script from AnyReplay and sends recordings to AnyReplay. It does nothing until you save a project key.

  • The recorder is loaded from https://cdn.anyreplay.com on every front-end page that records.
  • Recordings (page structure, mouse and touch movement, clicks, scrolls, typed values unless masked, page URLs, browser and device type, console errors and network request timings without bodies) are sent to https://in.anyreplay.com, or to the ingest URL you set.
  • Service: AnyReplay, operated by Baem Tech. Terms: https://anyreplay.com/legal/terms. Privacy policy: https://anyreplay.com/legal/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New and activate it.
  2. In AnyReplay, open your project’s setup page and copy the project key.
  3. In WordPress, open Settings → AnyReplay, paste the key and save.
  4. Open your site in a private window and click through a few pages. The setup page in AnyReplay switches to Connected when the first events arrive.

If a caching or optimisation plugin delays or combines JavaScript, exclude cdn.anyreplay.com/v1/ar.min.js and the inline AnyReplay script from it and clear the cache.
sections.faq:
Is AnyReplay GDPR compliant?

AnyReplay is built to be used in compliance with the GDPR, but compliance depends on how you use it. Turn on Wait for consent if your site asks visitors for consent before analytics, keep Mask form fields on for pages with personal data, and mention session recording in your privacy policy. AnyReplay offers a data processing agreement at https://anyreplay.com/legal/dpa.

Does it work with my cookie banner?

With Wait for consent on and a consent plugin that supports the WP Consent API (for example Complianz or CookieYes), recording starts only after a visitor allows the statistics category, and stops if they withdraw it. Other consent tools can switch on the same wait with the anyreplay_require_consent filter and call anyreplay('consent', true) from their own “accepted” callback.

What is never recorded?

Passwords, one-time codes and payment card fields are masked whatever you choose, and so is any value that looks like a card number. Add the CSS class ar-mask to a block to mask its text, or ar-block to leave it out of recordings altogether.

Does it record the WordPress admin?

No. The recorder is only added to front-end pages, and logged-in administrators are skipped by default.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, on pages your theme renders, including product, cart and checkout pages. Keep Mask form fields on for a shop.

Can I use it with a self-hosted AnyReplay?

Yes. Set the ingest URL to your own server. To load the recorder from your own host too, use the anyreplay_cdn_url filter.

Which hooks are there?

  • anyreplay_should_record (bool) — skip recording on some pages.
  • anyreplay_init_options (array) — change the options passed to the recorder.
  • anyreplay_require_consent (bool) — wait for consent without the setting.
  • anyreplay_consent_category (string) — the WP Consent API category, statistics by default.
  • anyreplay_cdn_url (string) — where the recorder is loaded from.
